Control FieldCurrent StandardFounder Use

Founder Release GatesLink

GatePass StandardIf Not Passed
Traceability confidenceRetrieval evidence, lot path, shipment proof, and evidence-gap language support the same answer.Keep challenge defense, recovery, and regulator-facing language bounded.
CAPA closureRoot cause, corrective action, preventive verification, owner, and next comparable-cycle proof are current.Keep complaint or inspection posture open under CAPA governance.
Supplier confidenceApproval, performance, traceability, CAPA, backup sourcing, and trust posture agree.Keep supplier approved with controls and block trust improvement.
Release packet confidenceDocument control, pre-shipment release, funding, shipment review, and executable-check evidence align.Do not widen movement or filing confidence.
Recovery confidenceCustomer remedy, supplier recovery, traceability, CAPA, account impact, and margin consequence are synchronized.Keep remedy provisional and refresh claims recovery.
Archive readinessCompliance work has no live proof gap, owner action, CAPA, claim, filing, release, or retrieval issue remaining.Keep the matter in active compliance control.

Protection and Escalation RulesLink

TriggerRequired ActionFounder Protection
Proof gap remains open while closure, recovery, release, or supplier confidence widensFreeze stronger language and refresh the owned proof room plus compliance dashboard.Prevents implied compliance closure.
Complaint remedy moves before CAPA, traceability, supplier recovery, and margin consequence agreeRoute through claims recovery, CAPA governance, account review, and profitability controls.Prevents commercial calm from hiding recurrence or margin risk.
Supplier trust improves while traceability, CAPA, or backup sourcing remains incompleteHold trust at controlled and refresh supplier approval plus performance board.Prevents sourcing confidence from outrunning proof.
Packet, release, funding, and executable-check records divergeStop movement expansion until control integrity is restored.Keeps release authority evidence-backed.
Compliance evidence is placed in protected templates or loose working filesMove evidence to the owned compliance, operations, CRM, or dashboard record.Preserves protected masters and keeps proof retrievable.
Archive is requested while any live compliance issue can still changeReturn to active compliance control and archive only after closeout criteria pass.Prevents unresolved work from leaving active view.
